title: papaya gossypiifolia
intro: Papaya gossypiifolia, commonly known as the calotrope or cotton plant of the papaya, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cucurbitaceae. This plant is known for its unique ability to secrete a milky sap when damaged, which has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of papaya gossypiifolia include the treatment of skin conditions, wounds, and inflammation, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of papaya gossypiifolia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
